policy.semanticClaims: filename and manifest signal classification only; no auditioning, voice identification or words/transcript claim
policy.originals: All 39 source files copied byte-for-byte with original filenames into audio/rc133/originals
policy.playbackDeduplication: exact original SHA-256 only; every original remains preserved and each unique nonvoice SHA has at most one playback derivative
policy.formats: small OGG Opus one-shots for nonvoice SFX; MP3 for BGM
policy.staticGain: Apply manifest recommended_source_static_gain_db, then only additional static attenuation if final decoded peak safety targets require it
policy.dcRemoval: 2nd-order high-pass at 20 Hz on every derivative
policy.trimming: Trim only the manifest-measured leading interval below -50 dBFS, retaining 35 ms preroll; do not trim trailing source content
policy.fades: SFX 8 ms fade-in and 120 ms fade-out; BGM 4 s fade-in and 4 s fade-out for transition use
policy.peakVerification: FFmpeg volumedetect sample peak and ebur128 true peak measured on decoded final outputs; requested limits are -1.5 dBFS sample and -1.0 dBTP true peak
policy.clipping: Static attenuation lowers playback level; no limiter or source-clipping repair claim
policy.runtime: No runtime event/file mapping changes are included
